features.quote: Default cap: 25 turns, with early-stop when the model emits a clean termination (graceful-exit detector, below).
features.justification_quote: Too low a cap and you miss it; too high and cost explodes.

features.quote: the eval will punish models for the correct response (recognizing futility and stopping cleanly). That makes the eval actively misleading as a regression target
features.justification_quote: you could 'improve' your score by making models more stubborn, which is worse

features.quote: Ethical/scope note on the harness lying to the model: the environment-state-lie and silent-harness-bug tasks deliberately deceive the agent. That's fine and standard for this kind of robustness eval, but document it clearly
features.justification_quote: keep these tasks out of any training-data pipeline, since training on 'the environment lies to you' can degrade real-world tool trust
